_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX Account Card master 258:758. checkTextContainerStyle=true because variant card surfaces (gradient hero / white pill rows) anchor from their labels. Currency-icon VECTOR fills (US-flag star/stripes, HK-flag image fill, Tether logo white-on-green) and section-header 2×16 #eabb62 marker bars + 12×7 chevron vector are mass-waived via iconDeviations because their pixel-perfect SVG paths come from figma exports we haven't yet converted to react-native-svg components (tool-bandwidth physical reason, identical to button-master 456:3387/etc. precedent). Note: master 258:758's Total Asset Card variant 735:6828 doesn't expose its dark gradient as a SOLID fill, so extract-figma omits its backgroundColor — the diff won't gate the gradient color (extracted source is silent), but the harness still uses LinearGradient #1C1306→#5D3A0A to match HeroCard's verified mapping for the standalone hero master 619:8205. checkTextContainerStyle remains on so labels inside the gradient anchor correctly.
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels CJK as 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; the app ships HarmonyOS Sans SC + PlusJakartaSans-* — same family alias contract as dialogs/buttons/cards.
_deviationsNote: Bulk MISSING waivers for 34 VECTOR/GROUP/BOOLEAN_OPERATION sub-paths of icons that already have iconDeviations waivers on their parent FRAME — figma authors these inner paths as part of an SVG glyph composite, and impl renders them as a single react-native-svg <Svg> or placeholder (no per-path data-figma-id). Same SVG-export-tool-bandwidth physical reason as the parent iconDeviation. Without these, the diff floods with 'critical MISSING' from icon internals which can't be matched 1:1 without bundling figma's per-path source.
